name: NSF NAIRR Two-Year Progress Update
known_limitations: NSF reports program reach and the transition plan. Aggregate project and student counts do not establish research quality, utilization depth, equitable access, durable operations, or outcomes from individual allocations.
automation_notes: Track the Operations Center award, sustained funding, provider participation, allocation utilization, and project-level outputs.
notes: NSF reports more than 600 supported research projects and 6,000 students across all U.S. states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico.
